notes_for_editor: Brief local unit (Thompson-Nicola) matches the firelookout.ca label. Several other Baldy towers exist, so do not merge records by name: Baldy Hughes (Fraser - Fort George, 53.617, 122.95), Baldy N.T. (Okanagan - Similkameen), Mount Baldy near Penticton (1925 unit), and a Baldy Mountain near Longworth in the Prince George area (hiking.princegeorge.tech, a different mountain). No source gives a build year, builder, staffing or fire history, so the story is short. Access and ownership are unknown. A BC Forest Fire Lookouts Facebook thread mentions Baldy Mountain but could not be read. Budget: four searches used, against a limit of two.
